select fp.SECID finprodMarketId, fp.SECNAME finprodAbbr, fp.SECNAME finprodName, fp.MARKET tradeMarket, sdl3.item_value tradeMarketStr, fp.ISSUERSHORT issueRshort, ci1.CUSTOMER_NAME issuershortStr, fp.ISSUEAMT nomCapi, fp.PROTECT_OBJECT protectObject, sdl4.item_value protectObjectStr, NULL refSecFeatures, fp.PROTECTED_BOND refSec, fp.REF_ENTITY refEntity, ci2.CUSTOMER_NAME refEntityStr, fp.MDATE mdate, fp.VDATE vdate, NULL gracePeriod, fp.BOOK_BUILDING_DATE bookBuildingDate, fp.PAY_DATE payDate, fp.CIRCULATION_DATE listingDate, NULL calendarId, fp.ISSUEPRICE issuePrice, fp.RATEBASIC basis, fp.SETTLE_METHOD settleMethod, sdl2.item_value settleMethodStr, fpa.IS_ALLOW_OVERWRITE isAllowOverwrite, sdl1.item_value isOrNoStr, NULL remark FROM INTERF_CREDITINFO fp LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp2 ON fp.SECID = fp2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpa ON fp2.FINPROD_ID = fpa.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO ci1 ON fp.ISSUERSHORT = ci1.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO ci2 ON fp.REF_ENTITY = ci2.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl1 ON sdl1.dict_code = 'YES_OR_NO' AND sdl1.item_code = fpa.IS_ALLOW_OVERWRITE LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl2 ON sdl2.dict_code = 'SETTLE_METHOD' LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl3 ON sdl3.dict_code = 'TRADE_PLACE' AND sdl3.item_code = fp.MARKET LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl4 ON sdl4.dict_code = 'PROTECT_OBJECT' AND sdl4.item_code = fp.PROTECT_OBJECT
AND fp.SECID = #{finprodMarketId}
